description: Cargo.toml declares features p384 and ed25519 (and groups them under rustcrypto) but lib.rs has no implementation for either. Enabling the rustcrypto feature (which is the documented FIPS-alternative path) silently compiles without P-384 or Ed25519 support. DefaultVerifier will return Err(SignatureError::new()) for P-384/Ed25519 OIDs without any indication that the feature was supposed to provide them. The crate-level docs claim rustcrypto wires in RSA-PSS, P-384, Ed25519 (line 15-16) which is false for v0.1. Either remove those features from v0.1 or add a compile_error! if they are enabled.
title: p384 and ed25519 features declared but no implementation exists
